name: Birgit Brinda
headline: Senior Infrastructure & Energy Investment Professional
summary:
Senior Infrastructure & Energy Finance/ Investment Banking Professional with proven track record of closing large scale structured financings in various jurisdictions across Europe, North and Latin America. Led international teams across a wide range of sectors, including digital & core infrastructure, core+, renewable energy (offshore & onshore wind, solarthermal/CSP, Solar PV), conventional energy and midstream. As of late specific focus on energy transition topics, such as hydrogen and battery storage.
Originated, structured and executed on >$20bn of transactions, many of which received industry recognition awards and involved diverse senior and junior financing products in private credit and capital markets, as well as structured derivatives and debt & equity advisory. 
Experienced in equity/ development finance, private equity type (acquisition) financings, P3/PPP, senior & mezz project finance as well as working with multilateral institutions, ECAs and rating agencies. 
Creative problem-solver with entrepreneurial mindset, and trusted partner in complex situations.

positions.title: Director, Infrastructure & Energy, EMEA
positions.description:
Senior transactor responsible for and leading project teams for >€ 10bn of structured financings across infrastructure and (mostly renewable) power sectors. Ran multiple financial advisory assignments in Public-Private-Partnership/PFI bidding processes for platinum industrial and institutional sponsors. Lead role in a number of offshore wind projects, in advisory, senior debt and/or derivatives capacity. Structured and executed senior and subordinated debt in development financings in key European renewables markets, with an equity-type risk profile on DB's balance sheet. Responsible for all aspects of the credit work, incl. negotiation of financial documentation, credit/investment process, due diligence, supervision of financial modeling, etc. Ran debt and equity placement as well as rating processes. Structures often also involved ECA and development bank/ multilateral tranches.
Promoted to Director in Jan 2012. Responsible for training and mentoring junior team members since very early days of my career.
